store_data.about_the_game:
Your first day. Their last day.

You're the newest hire at Exterminator Inc., a small but proud pest control company with a big problem: every single client property is crawling with something. Roaches in the kitchen. Dustbunnies in the bathroom. Things you don't have names for yet in the attic.

Lucky for you, the company hands out a broom, a stopwatch, and exactly zero training. The rest is up to your clicking finger.

A Clicker That Actually Hits Back

Exterminator Inc. is a time-survival clicker built around one simple idea: the more bugs you smash, the more time you buy. No auto-battle, no idle waiting — every kill is something you earn with a click. Crit, combo, and chain your way through swarms until the timer runs out... or you do.

Five Tools, Five Ways to Crush

Start with the trusty Broom, then unlock the Spray, Vacuum, Mop, and Bleach Gun as you climb the corporate ladder. Each weapon completely changes how you play — from rapid hold-to-fire sprays to auto-targeting mops that clear the whole room while you focus on the big ones.

Build the Ultimate Exterminator

Spend your hard-earned gold on a 5-branch pentagon skill tree packed with damage boosts, crit chances, time bonuses, auto-attack drones, and 7 powerful synergies that reward bold builds. Maxed out everything? You've officially become Employee of the Month.

Four Rooms. One Promotion.

Work your way from the humble Kitchen to the dreaded Attic, each with its own bugs, bosses, and survival timer. Every cleared room unlocks the next — and every failed shift teaches you a little more about what's hiding behind the wallpaper.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build a college baseball program from the ground up.

Road to Omaha is a college baseball dynasty management sim built for fans who love recruiting battles, roster decisions, pitch-by-pitch games, deep stats, and the long arc of turning a program into a national contender.



Take over a school, shape your roster, build your staff, set your strategy, and guide your team through season after season of college baseball.

Run the Program


Every season is about more than the games on the schedule. Recruit high school prospects, chase transfers, manage scholarships, upgrade facilities, hire assistants, and decide how your program should grow.

Build around power bats, elite defense, deep pitching, speed, or whatever identity fits the roster you create.

  • Recruit high school players and transfers
  • Manage roster needs, player development, and offseason progression
  • Hire and develop coaching staff
  • Upgrade facilities and build program prestige
  • Navigate draft decisions, transfers, injuries, and long-term roster turnover

Shape Every Season


Build your schedule, play weekend series and midweek games, chase conference titles, and fight for postseason seeding. Sim ahead when you want speed, or slow down and manage the moments that matter.

The dynasty keeps moving across unlimited seasons, with history, records, awards, rankings, and program expectations following you year after year.

Play or Sim Pitch by Pitch


Games are presented as a sports-app-style simulation, not an arcade action game. Follow every pitch through live play-by-play, box scores, win probability, fatigue, leverage, pitch counts, and batter/pitcher matchups.

Jump in for key innings, manage every pitch, or instantly sim the result.

  • Pitch-by-pitch game simulation
  • Live box scores and play-by-play
  • Bullpen management, fatigue, and pitching changes
  • Lineup, rotation, and strategy control
  • Traditional and advanced baseball stats

Dig Into the Details


Road to Omaha is built for players who like the spreadsheet side of sports. Player ratings, handedness, pitch repertoires, fatigue, injury status, development, season logs, career stats, team history, and advanced metrics are always close by.

Set lineups, depth charts, rotations, bullpen roles, travel squads, and player development priorities.

Customize Your World


Play in a fictional college baseball universe, or customize the experience with team names, colors, logos, conferences, stadiums, and more. Sandbox tools let you edit players and shape your save the way you want.

Key Features

He must MASTER POOJITSU to stop the Princess.

He’ll HARNESS GLITCH POWERS and the code holding everything together.

Can DungDung save the realm AND the game?

WHY GIVE A CRAP ABOUT DUNGDUNG?

  • Martial arts action-platforming. With dung!

    • Master the arts of Poojitsu and Dung Fu!

    • ...and ride a Dung Ball!

    • Meet new allies along the way (and play as them as well)!

  • Glitch powers & abilities imported from other "games!"

    • See the other side of the screen in Gray Box mode.

    • Fight corrupted creatures from other games in NullShrines.

    • Gain abilities that change how you interact with the game world.

We've still got a long way to go, but hope you'll join us on the adventure. This won't stink!

store_data.about_the_game:
Serve drinks, survive ridiculous guests, upgrade your bars, and buy out rival moguls — solo or in co-op — in a chill bar empire game where every shift ends in progress.

Survive Ridiculous Guests

Your customers are more than walking orders.

Some leave generous tips. Some steal your coins. Some fall asleep on the counter and block your lane. Some jump onto the bar and dance until every incoming drink shatters. Others may drop suspicious gifts, change their order mid-shift, or even kidnap the bartender and throw them out the door.

Learn each guest’s behavior, react to their abilities, and turn unpredictable bar chaos into profit.

Build your Bars, One Chaotic Shift at a Time.

Busy Bar is a chill arcade-management game about serving drinks, handling ridiculous guests, upgrading unique bars and buying out rival moguls across the world.

Every shift ends in progress. There are no harsh fail states or game-over days — you always earn something, improve something, and move one step closer to owning the next bar. The challenge is not whether you survive the day, but how well you handle the chaos.

Build a Global Bar Empire

Start small, then expand across the world. Travel between cities on the world map, discover new bars, and decide where to work next.

Each bar has its own layout, style, guest mix, upgrade path, and owner. Some are cheap starter pubs, others are expensive premium venues controlled by powerful rivals. Earn money, buy them out, and grow your empire one property at a time.

Upgrade and Personalize your Bars

Spend your earnings between shifts to improve each bar. Unlock new equipment, activate extra counters, change walls and floors, place decorations, and watch your venue visibly transform as it levels up. Each levels increase your profit in shifts.

Your upgrades are not just numbers in a menu — bought items appear directly inside the bar. A rough little pub can slowly become a stylish, profitable venue that feels like your own.

Defeat Rival Bar Moguls

You are not the only one building an empire.

The Mogul Rankings track rival bar tycoons, their wealth, their bars, and their position on the leaderboard. As you buy their properties and increase your own wealth, you climb the rankings and push them down.

Take a mogul’s last bar, and they disappear from the leaderboard completely. One less rival. One step closer to the top.

Play Solo or in Local Co-op

Run the bar alone or bring a friend in local 4-player co-op on one shared screen. Choose different bartenders, split the work, rescue each other from trouble, or accidentally make everything worse.

Co-op adds coordination, chaos, and plenty of funny moments — especially when guests start blocking lanes, breaking drinks, or dragging bartenders across the room.

Run Chaotic Bar Shifts

Step behind the counter, charge your throw, and slide drinks down the lane to waiting customers. Recall empty glasses, collect tips, clean up spills, and keep the bar moving as orders pile up.

The controls are simple to learn, but each shift becomes a satisfying mix of timing, positioning, and optimization. Pick a short, normal, or long shift, then try to earn as much as you can before the day ends.

Key Features

  • Chill, shift-based arcade-management gameplay

  • No harsh fail states — every shift ends in progress

  • Drink throwing, glass recalling, tip collecting, and cleanup

  • 25 different type of ridiculous guests with 15+ different abilities including sleepers, dancers, thieves, bombs, reorders, and kidnappers

  • Local 1-4 player co-op on one shared screen

  • Unique bars with different layouts, styles, guests, and upgrades

  • Visible bar progression with new counters, items, walls, floors, and decorations

  • World map travel between cities and bars

  • Rival Mogul leaderboard with buyouts and empire progression

  • Multiple bartenders with different looks and animations

Busy Bar is a cozy-chaotic bar game about relaxed optimization, funny accidents, and the satisfaction of turning one small pub into a worldwide bar empire.

store_data.about_the_game:
LOAD. AIM. DOMINATE.

Tank Them All is a chaotic top-down arena shooter where six tanks enter — and only one leaves. Blast your friends into oblivion across 90+ hand-crafted arenas, grab game-changing power-ups, and survive everything from poison clouds to air raids.

4 GAME MODES. ENDLESS CHAOS.

⚔ Free For All

Pure, unfiltered mayhem. Last tank rolling wins. Set your own rules — play by rounds or rack up kills.

🤝 Team Battle

Two teams, one winner. Revive fallen teammates with the Repair power-up and coordinate fire — friendly fire is OFF, but accidents happen.

🏆 King of the Hill

A glowing zone appears on the arena. Hold it. Score points every second you're inside. But the zone shrinks — and moves. Respawn, adapt, survive.

🐚 Golden Shell

One golden shell drops somewhere on the map. Pick it up and you become the most dangerous — and most hunted — tank on the battlefield. Score points every second you hold it. Kill while holding for a bonus. Die and it's gone.

16 POWER-UPS. INFINITE COMBINATIONS.

Collect up to 3 power-ups simultaneously and stack brutal combinations:

  • Homing Missile— locks on and chases enemies

  • Bounce Bullet — ricochets off walls to hit from impossible angles

  • Boomerang — fires forward, curves back, hits twice

  • Explosion Shell — area-damage devastation

  • Nitro — speed boost to chase or escape

  • Shield — absorbs one lethal hit

  • Ice Path — leave a slippery trail that disrupts enemies

  • Dash Killer — your dash becomes a lethal weapon

  • Artillery — call in a strike from above

  • Mine — plant traps and control the arena

  •  ...and 6 more

THE ARENA FIGHTS BACK.

Surviving other players isn't enough. Every match can bring:

  • ☁ Poison Cloud — deadly gas closes in from the edges

  • 💣 Minefield — the battlefield perimeter becomes a death zone

  • 🌪 Tornado — weather turns violent during storms

  • ✈ Air Raid — bombs fall from the sky at timed intervals

90+ ARENAS. NEVER THE SAME MATCH TWICE.

Sand dunes. Dense jungles. Lakes. Radar stations. Each arena is a different battlefield — different cover, different flow, different strategy. A new arena is loaded every round.

LOCAL & ONLINE — PLAY YOUR WAY.

🎮 Local Multiplayer

Up to 6 players on one machine. Couch chaos at its finest.

🌐 Online Multiplayer

Create a lobby and share a code, or browse open rooms and jump straight in. Fill any empty slot with AI bots — whether you're playing locally or online.

No matter how you play, bots adapt to the game mode: they hunt power-ups, contest King of the Hill zones, and chase down the Golden Shell holder.

QUICK TO LEARN. HARD TO MASTER.

One stick to move. One button to charge and fire. Then it gets complicated — in the best possible way.

Our SuperSub Scientists have distilled the beautiful game down to its simplest core:

Place a new player on the field ("sub them on"). They kick nearby balls away.

Take your squad from the first group match to the challenging final. Earn money for scoring goals, buy upgrades, beat teams to advance. Win the world cup in whatever way you like.

  • Want to score beautiful goals? Upgrade your passes, curve shots, and more like an incremental game.

  • Want to tackle the opponent into oblivion? You can! Upgrade fouls to always go in your favor and kick the referee off the field before they can complain.

Is this for me?

Relive that magical World Cup vibe without any extra complexity, controls, or insider ball knowledge needed.

Chill out and have fun trying to win the tournament. Or get sweaty as your favorite team. Beat the different computer opponents in creative ways ... or through sheer brutality. 

Upgrade your team into the style you like the most. Or just the one that gives you the most satisfying pings as you earn mountains of money.

Hunt. Cook. Descend. Repeat.

In a world where food has grown scarce, brave Food Hunters venture into cursed dungeons in search of the ultimate ingredients — creatures known as Food Monsters.

Sumeeper fuses the deduction logic of Minesweeper with roguelike dungeon crawling. Every tile you flip is a calculated risk. Every monster you face has unique abilities. Every run ends differently.

Uncover a grid of hidden tiles. Numbers reveal the combined level of nearby monsters — use logic to find safe paths and pinpoint dangerous foes.

store_data.about_the_game:
SRPG in Search of Balance

On a continent where the ideals of three nations clash, what will you choose, and what will you defend?

“Verdant Requiem” is a scenario-driven SRPG that combines classic tactical gameplay with epic, war-chronicle-style scenarios, branching narratives, and a unique military management system.

This is not a story where good and evil are simply divided. Resources, faith, military power, and national ambitions—as the ideals and contradictions held by each nation clash, the protagonist Leonis and his companions are drawn into a battle for the balance of the continent.

The fate of this continent rests entirely on your choices.

Long-Form Scenario SRPG

This title is a long-form SRPG designed to offer over 40 hours of gameplay, including in-game time and free scenarios.

The story features branching paths, with each route taking approximately 12 to 17 hours to complete. Depending on the path you choose, the portrayal of nations, the positions of your allies, and the ending will all change.

In addition to the main scenario, free scenarios are also available, allowing you to enjoy the ensemble drama through flashback events told from each character’s perspective.

While there is no permanent character loss, penalties for injuries do exist. Rather than irreversible loss, we aimed to balance tension and playability by ensuring the results of battle remain within your army.

Classic Tactical System

The combat in this game emphasizes the tactical depth of classic SRPGs.

In addition to basic strategic elements like the rock-paper-scissors weapon system, special attacks, and skills, we’ve implemented a follow-up attack system triggered by flanking maneuvers based on positioning, as well as a combat skill system that leverages each character’s unique traits.

It’s not just about defeating enemies—it’s about deciding which unit to place where, who to have initiate the attack, and when to use combat skills. We aimed to create battles true to the SRPG genre, where every single decision changes the course of the battle.

A War-Themed Fantasy Focused on Story

“Verdant Requiem” is not your typical fantasy tale of good versus evil, but rather a war-themed story where the ideals and conspiracies of various nations intertwine.

At the heart of the story lies the balance among three nations: a nation rich in resources, a nation driven by faith, and a nation built on trade and scholarship. The circumstances each faces are far from simple, and even their adversaries have reasons they cannot compromise on.

While the story primarily follows Leonis as the protagonist, free scenarios and flashback events also shine a spotlight on his companions and figures from each nation. To ensure that no character is overshadowed, the number of ally units has been designed to be slightly smaller than in conventional SRPG titles.

In exchange, we place great emphasis on carefully depicting each character’s background, stance, and relationships.

Attention to Visual Presentation

To make the story and combat more memorable, we have put significant effort into the visual presentation.

During combat, we incorporate cut-in animations and combat skill effects, while in event scenes, we use weather effects, fog, lighting, and cinematographic techniques to convey the atmosphere of each moment. We’ve also incorporated simulated bloom, water reflections, and noise effects, paying close attention to the overall visual atmosphere despite the game being created with SRPG Studio.

Additionally, through character sprite blinking, sprite animations, modified assets, and the introduction of original sprites, we have strived to move away from the impression of default assets as much as possible and create a visual style unique to this title.

Unique Systems

In addition to the standard tactical map, this title implements several unique systems for managing your army.

Notable examples include Logistics Management, which handles salt, food, and minerals, and Attribute Balance, where the protagonist Leonis’s attributes and the army’s overall capabilities change based on the player’s actions.

Additionally, facilities and elements that support the army outside of combat, such as the Mobile Mess Hall and the Spell Mineral Research Lab, also make an appearance.

It’s not just about winning on the battlefield; how you use limited supplies, how you maintain your army, and the direction you lead it in—these decisions are also crucial elements of this game.

A Slightly More Complex Design, Including Resource Management

This game is not just a simple SRPG where you simply conquer maps.

In terms of military logistics, you’ll manage three resources: salt, food, and minerals. Additionally, the protagonist’s attributes change based on the player’s actions, affecting both allied units and the army as a whole.

As a result, this game may not be suitable for those seeking a simple, casual SRPG. On the other hand, for players who want to deeply engage with the story, tactics, and military management, we aim to provide a challenging and rewarding experience.

Recommended for:

・Fans of SRPGs ・Fans of war stories or scenario-driven games ・Fans of stories involving international intrigue and clashing ideologies ・Players who want to delve deeply into character backgrounds and relationships ・Players who want to enjoy the tactical depth of classic SRPGs ・Players who want to enjoy resource management and military administration elements ・Players who want to experience an SRPG Studio title with unique presentation and visuals

The player’s choices will influence not only Leonis and his companions’ journey but also the very fate of the continent itself.

Will you preserve the balance? Or will you shatter it?

Your choices will determine the continent’s ultimate fate.

store_data.about_the_game:
The abyss 3km beneath the ice—where silence is your only shield against death.

'NUNBORA: Frostblind' is a 3D 4-player co-op PvE extraction shooter set in an isolated arctic underground research facility.

Following a catastrophic drilling accident by 'Snowdrop Industries (SDI)', a futuristic energy exploration corporation, ancient predators frozen for tens of thousands of years have awakened 3 kilometers beneath the Greenland ice sheet. Players step into the shoes of workers struggling to survive, exploring the pitch-black darkness and blinding blizzards. Evade the horrific threat of these ancient creatures, secure vital resources, and safely extract back to the survival bunker with your team.

Key Features

🤫 Extreme Tension: Silence or Death

The predators of this abyss are extremely sensitive to sound. Every action you take—walking, sprinting, scavenging, or mining—is translated into real-time decibel (dB) levels. The moment your noise exceeds a certain threshold, you and your teammates instantly become targets for the ravenous monsters. Every second demands a choice: move in absolute stealth, or risk it all and sprint with your hard-earned resources.

🤝 Strategy-Driven Co-op PvE Extraction

Leave behind the high-stress encounters of PvP and the anxiety of being looted by other players. This game is designed purely for cooperative PvE teamwork. Appointing bait to distract predators, securing safe extraction routes, and watching each other's backs are the only keys to survival.

🗺️ An Ever-Changing, Unforgiving Environment

The world outside the safe zone never becomes familiar. Every expedition features a procedurally generated map where the layout, resource distribution, and monster spawn points are completely randomized. Even during repeated playthroughs, new crises await, delivering fresh tension with every match.

🎭 A Striking Visual Contrast of Cute and Grotesque

Experience a powerful visual juxtaposition between the cute, charming player characters resiliently surviving the harsh environment, and the spine-chilling, grotesque ancient predators they face. This unique art style blends seamlessly with a cold, neon-glow UI to deliver a fresh yet terrifyingly immersive atmosphere.

Can you survive and escape the deepest, coldest grave on Earth?

Tachyon Fire is a fast-paced arena FPS inspired by the gameplay of Devil Daggers, the movement of Tribes, and the game-feel of Quake III.  Evolve your weapons using the harvested energy of your enemies. Master each level by optimizing your movement and crowd control to achieve the fastest completion time.

Mechanical fiends have overrun the projected realm of the collective unconscious. With the Kali Yuga reaching its 400,000-year apex, it falls to you, Metatron, to blast them to smithereens and purge the Akashic code of their corruption.

Features:

  • FPS, Purified
    There is no fall damage, reloading, regenerating health, or randomly generated gameplay. Your strategy, movement, and aim alone determine your fate in the arena. Rapidly switch between 3 distinct weapons, each with 3 upgrade levels, to annihilate foes with escalating intensity.

  • Undulating Walls of Flesh and Chrome
    Learn to overpower nine enemy types as massive swarms overwhelm you. Some will slither and coil, others will lumber, and still others will swirl into clouds or raise fluid shield-walls.

  • Movement Sandbox
    Ski, slide, bounce, bunny hop, shotgun jump, and machine-gun boost across the arena however you choose.

  • Demiurge
    Enjoy a handcrafted experience built almost entirely by a single developer. The engine, levels, sound design and most models were created from the ground up as a labor of love.

About This Game

It was just another Friday night.

You were sitting in your room, controller in hand, losing yourself in the glow of the TV screen. The pizza was getting cold. The world outside didn't matter. It was just you and the game — the way it was always meant to be.

Then something happened.

The screen flickered. The colors twisted. The room around you began to blur and stretch, like reality itself was being pulled apart at the seams. Before you could react, before you could even scream — the TV swallowed you whole.

Welcome to a world that wants you dead.

You wake up in a dark, cold dungeon. Stone walls. Torchlight. The distant sound of something shuffling in the shadows. And then a voice — desperate, familiar, human.

"Hey! Over here! Keep it down — they'll hear you!"

His name is Roman. He's been trapped here longer than he can remember, surviving on instinct and sheer stubbornness. He doesn't know how you got here. He doesn't know why. But he knows one thing with absolute certainty:

"I need your help to get out of this world. And trust me — this world does NOT want us to leave."

Every step is a death sentence.

Spikes&Traps is a brutal, unforgiving 2D action platformer where the environment is your greatest enemy. The ground beneath your feet hides razor-sharp spikes. The walls launch arrows the moment you get too close. Platforms collapse under your weight. Pendulums swing without warning. And the enemies — the zombies, the creatures that lurk in the dark — they don't stop. They don't rest. They don't care how many times you've already died today.

Because in this world, death is not the end. It's just the beginning of another attempt.

Master movement. Master combat. Master survival.

You are not helpless. As you push deeper into this cursed world, you grow stronger. You learn. You adapt.

  • Wall Jump your way up sheer vertical surfaces, reaching places that seem impossible

  • Dash through danger at blinding speed, slipping past traps that would shred anyone else

  • Double Jump to clear gaps that stretch across the abyss

  • Glide through the air, buying precious seconds to plan your next move

  • Stomp enemies into the ground from above, turning their own aggression against them

  • Climb walls, navigate narrow passages, and find paths that others would miss

And when the enemies get too close — you have a sword. Use it well.

A Skill Tree built for survivors.

Every challenge you overcome makes you stronger. Earn experience, level up, and invest in a deep skill tree that lets you shape your playstyle. Unlock new abilities. Upgrade your stats. Become the kind of warrior this world fears.

But choose wisely. Every skill point matters. Every upgrade could mean the difference between escaping — or becoming another forgotten soul in the dungeon's endless darkness.

Quests, stories, and secrets.

Roman isn't the only soul trapped here. As you explore, you'll encounter NPCs — survivors, wanderers, lost souls with stories of their own. Some will give you quests. Some will warn you of dangers ahead. Some might even help you, if you earn their trust.

Complete missions, collect rewards, and piece together the mystery of this world. Why does it exist? How do people end up here? And most importantly — is there really a way out?

Built for those who refuse to quit.

Spikes&Traps does not hold your hand. There are no tutorials that pause the game and explain everything. There are no checkpoints every thirty seconds. There is no easy mode.

There is only you, the level, and the question: how many times are you willing to die before you figure it out?

If you've ever thrown a controller in frustration and then immediately picked it back up — this game is for you.

If you believe that the best victories are the ones you had to earn — this game is for you.

If you want a 2D platformer that actually challenges you — this game is for you.

  • Rich story with memorable characters

  • Deep skill tree with unlockable abilities

  • Fast-paced sword combat system

  • Deadly traps, enemies, and environmental hazards

  • Quest and dialogue system

  • Full controller support

  • Steam Achievements

  • Designed to challenge — and reward — those who persist

store_data.about_the_game:
A fallen god, a corrupted ocean

In a time long forgotten, a divine entity crashed upon the Earth. Its aura, shattered upon impact, scattered soul pieces into the depths of the waters, genetically mutating the aquatic fauna. In Deeplords, embark on a dark and melancholic journey to uncover the truth behind the fall, confronting the monstrosities that now dwell in the abyss.



Navigate the unknown in HD-2D

Explore an atmospheric world where gorgeous 3D dioramas blend with high-resolution pixel art characters and creatures. Aboard your motorboat, you will travel across five unique and hostile biomes: from infected swamps to frozen expanses, up to eerie bodies of water dominated by gigantic bone shards emerging from the depths.



The Art of the Harpoon

There are no random encounters in the corrupted ocean. Spot the shadows beneath the surface and cast your harpoon in the open world. Every successful hook triggers a dice roll that determines the fate of the engagement, adding a layer of tactical tension before the clash even begins.



Lethal Synergies and Turn-Based Combat

Deeplords offers a deep tactical combat system based on dice and unique chain reactions for each team. Simply attacking is not enough: you must set the board and trigger the perfect "Payoff."

  • Fire: Inflict Burn, stack Fuel, and trigger a brutal Detonate.

  • Ice: Freeze the enemy Frozen create Crystal, and shatter them with Crack.

  • Skeleton: Harness souls with Revive, invoke a Rite, and awaken the dead Wake.

  • Alien, Swamp, and Basic: Push the mind beyond its limits to cause a Glitch, drown victims in the mud Drown or shatter the enemy's guard to leave them Open.



    Catch, Fuse, and Evolve

    Every creature you catch has a rarity tier (Base, Rare, Epic, or Legendary). But fishing is only the beginning. Collect specimens of the same species and fuse them together to force their evolution. Increase the rarity of your fish to unlock the best elemental combinations and build an unstoppable team. The abyss does not forgive the weak: adapt your synergies or sink with them.

store_data.about_the_game:
Kung-fu meets cosmic card combat

Kung-Fu Space Fighters is a roguelike deckbuilder where Earth’s martial artists face off against bizarre alien warriors in a chaotic interstellar tournament.

But there is one twist: battles play out automatically.

You do not manually choose every attack during combat. Instead, you build the deck, shape the strategy, control the cost curve, collect artifacts, and prepare your fighter before each battle begins.

Slot-based auto-battles

Each turn, cards are drawn and placed into three action slots with different power limits.

Slot 1 plays cheap, fast actions.

Slot 2 supports stronger mid-cost cards.

Slot 3 enables your most powerful moves.

If a card fits the slot, it activates.

If it is too expensive, it folds and does nothing.

Victory depends on building a deck that flows correctly through the slots. A powerful card is useless if it keeps appearing in the wrong place. A cheap card can become deadly if it enables the right combo at the right time.

Build for consistency, chaos, or explosive combos

Every run challenges you to create a deck that can survive unpredictable battles.

You can focus on reliable low-cost cards that almost always activate, powerful expensive cards that dominate when they land, adaptive cards that work in multiple slots, combo chains that reward perfect 1-2-3 turn sequences, or defensive builds that block, stall, poison, burn, and outlast enemies.

The fight happens automatically, but the outcome is shaped by every deckbuilding decision you made before it.

Artifacts change the rules

Artifacts can bend the combat system in your favor.

Some reward clean slot sequences.

Some turn failed cards into value.

Some empower cheap cards in expensive slots.

Some completely change how you evaluate your deck.

A bad curve can become a strategy.

A failed card can become a shield.

A simple attack can become the final hit of a deadly combo.

Fight alien martial artists

Your enemies are not passive targets. Each opponent has their own deck, rhythm, pressure pattern, and dangerous tricks.

You will face alien fighters, strange cultists, elite warriors, and powerful bosses who test whether your deck can handle more than just raw damage.

Some enemies pressure you early.

Some weaken your fighter.

Some poisons, burns, blocks, or scales over time.

Some force your deck to survive bad turns.

Choose your path through the tournament

Between battles, travel across a roguelike map filled with combat encounters, events, shops, upgrades, elites, and bosses.

Take safer paths to stabilize your deck.

Challenge elites for greater rewards.

Visit shops to remove weak cards or buy key pieces.

Collect artifacts that unlock new strategies.

Prepare for boss fights that punish careless deckbuilding.

A roguelike deckbuilder about preparation

Kung-Fu Space Fighters is about making the right decisions before the chaos begins.

You do not control every punch.

You control the system that throws them.

Build the deck.

Tune the curve.

Trust the slots.

Survive the tournament

Defend. Survive. Kill some zombies.

IsoDead TD is an isometric tower game with a hybrid aesthetic, with classic mechanics and a zombie theme. Place towers along the path, recruit heroes with unique passives, and hold the hordes that grow wave after wave. How long can you last?

What's inside

  • Variety of towers — shooter, sniper, flamethrower, freezer, cannon and more, each with its own personality

  • Upgrade paths — choose how your tower evolves

  • Recruitable heroes with helpful passives

  • Tactical abilities — air bomb, reinforcements, repair

  • Maps across several difficulties — from Easy to Nightmare

  • Endless mode — for those who never get tired

  • Achievements and online leaderboards

Who made it

Made solo by me — with essential help from my friends in testing. It's my first published game, and it had to be a tower defense: I've loved the genre since I was a kid. Put a lot of care into it.

What it does NOT have

  • Microtransactions

  • Battle pass / season pass

  • Ads

  • Gem / energy system

Just a game. Buy once, that's it.

Who it's for

For those who love classic tower defense, want to relax killing zombies, and enjoy games that are quick to finish — with variety to bring you back several times.

Available in

Portuguese · English · Spanish · Chinese

Supports mouse, keyboard and gamepad (Xbox).

Good luck. And have fun!

— Thiago

store_data.about_the_game:
Do you remember the time when there was nothing superfluous in games? No daily rewards, no donations, no mythical rarity of blocks. Only a 10x20 grid and seven types of shapes that fall faster and faster.

"Oh no, not another L" is a fair puzzle game in an old design.

What's inside:

· Classic Tetris mechanics without perversions. Twist, shift, harddrop — just the way you like it.

· Minimalistic graphics in the spirit of the early 90s. No post-effects, gradients or volumetric shadows.

· High score table (local). Only one number matters — your best score. You play, you make mistakes,

you start over and try to write a new line.

About the music separately:

The background melody is looped in such a way that it does not infuriate even in the second hour of the game. A calm, slightly melancholic chillwave without abrupt transitions.

Why "Oh no, not another L"?

Because the L-shaped figure always comes at the most inopportune moment. You lick an even glass, and bam, that curve squiggles again. And you either find a place for her, or you lose. No options.

store_data.about_the_game:
The dead are walking, the kingdom is on fire, the king is terrified, and your only hope lies with the ancient remains of a giant robot that was scattered across the kingdom ages ago.

Knights v Zombies is a 1-4 player local couch co-op hack and slash adventure with the structural integrity of a six-year-old's daydream and the production values of a software engineer who's addicted to Humble Bundles.

Six levels. Six wildly different vibes.

  • The Castle - Zombies in the throne room. Smash the furniture on the way out; the king's insurance will cover it.

  • The Village - The houses are burning. The villagers have fled. The helicopters are looking for a safe place to land. Wait, what?

  • The Forest - Grass warriors and spiders and rock monsters, oh my!

  • The High Seas - Because I wanted to make a game about pirates and Rare wouldn't give me a job.

  • The Mountain Caves - You ride giant ants here. Don't worry about it.

  • The Undead Kingdom - A massive fortress that could only be penetrated by a fifty-foot robot. Oh, you have one now? How convenient!

If you're still here after the giant ants, you might be the target audience. Here's the rest:

Features

  • 1-4 player local couch co-op

  • ~45 minutes of escalating chaos, start to credits

  • Hack and Slash combat that gets increasingly anachronistic...

  • Built in Unreal Engine 5 by a 6 year old boy (now 7, or probably 8 by the time I actually finish this), plus his dad who "just puts it in the computer."

  • Plug in up to four controllers. Keyboard works too, but a mouse is awkward on the couch...

This game is not: an open-world RPG, a roguelike, a soulslike, competitive, online, or the kind of game you'll be playing for 80 hours. It's a small silly thing you play on a couch with people you like.

If you have a couple controllers and a kid, a friend, or a cat with opposable thumbs, then give it a try! Net proceeds go to the creative director's college fund and my Humble Bundle addiction.

A NEW KIND OF AUTOBATTLER:
Kings of Oros is a mashup of Roguelike Autobattlers, and Roguelike Physics games. The goal was to combine the exciting watchability of bouncing plinko balls or battling marbles with deep player agency and build craft. Theorycraft your way through hordes of enemies and send your build into the ether to battle against other players online. Clutch battles will keep you on the edge of your seat!

BUILD CRAFT:
Forge enchanted and legendary armaments to enable powerful synergies and builds. The physics battle system provides unique opportunities for builds, like fast spinning dual wield daggers, or giant warhammers that grow larger with each kill!

HARNESS ELEMENTAL POWERS:

Shock enemies with lightning. Freeze and shatter your foes. Spread poisonous plagues as you fight through increasingly difficult battles. 

ENDLESS COMBINATIONS:

Hunt through hundreds of unique items. Equip your stones with weapons and relics. Visit specialized shops. Forge weapons together to acquire powerful enchantments and legendary items. Purchase and upgrade powerful blessing stones to create crazy synergies. 

CONTROL THE TEMPO OF BATTLE:

Equip cards to add rhythm to your strategy, unleashing timely spins, volleys of projectiles, giant growing weapons, aoe explosions and more. Curate, upgrade, and enchant your deck to get the upper hand against other players. Special classes, blessings and equipment can supercharge your cards or interact with them in unique ways.

CLASSES OF OROS:

Shower the screen with extra projectiles that ricochet throughout the arena by choosing the Volley class. Cycle rapidly through cards and receive powerful card buffs by choosing the Joker class. Or take the battlefield with a lone King stone, by choosing the Monarchy class, and overpower weaker foes.

CLASS UPGRADES:

All classes have unique sets of upgrades in addition to their base effect. Buzzsaw, for example, gains increased spin speed, and additional upgrades sync all your units together, or grant additional speed every time you deal damage.

ASYNCHRONUS PVP:

As you play, your builds are captured and pushed into other players runs. Meanwhile, your runs will be populated by a constant stream of real player opponents. Can you break the game and become the true King of Oros?

store_data.about_the_game:
In the spring of 1899, a terrible tragedy befell the house of the Blackwell family. After a fateful encounter, the family's maids, Pauline Lantier and Mary Catterick, inadvertently kill their master's son. The events that followed are shrouded in mystery, but the sordid tale of the Blackwells and their maids can only end in one way: the total downfall of Sir Arthur Blackwell and his lineage.

Take control of Pauline or Mary as you use skill checks, dice rolls, and dialogue choices to decide the fate of the Blackwells across dozens of unique endings. Use your time wisely to improve your stats and gain new skills. You'll need them to overcome the ever-harder challenges that follow the very murder you committed. Will you hang onto your faith and conscience and try to cover up your crime? You'll need a razor-sharp wit and an even sharper tongue to get away with it. Or will you instead choose to embrace violence and take revenge on a world that has shown you nothing but cruelty and suffering? Become one with your inner predator and seize freedom through strength. The fate of the Blackwell family balances on the edge of your knife.

Key features

  • Get away with murder, one way or another: To get away with murder, you'll need a plan. A carefully crafted web of lies and trickery can throw suspicion onto someone else. Or, if that fails, you could simply leave nobody alive to witness your crime.

  • More than 35 unique endings: Choose how the stories of Pauline and Mary will unfold. Your decisions shape the story and lead to many different fates.

  • Use your time wisely: Carefully manage your time to raise your stats and manipulate members of the household. Enact your most cunning schemes; will you lay the blame on another member of the house? Make the body disappear? Or simply use the time to eliminate a potential witness?

  • Unlockable progression: Complete endings to grant yourself new skills and improved stats. Use your accumulated knowledge to unlock new story paths.

Fun Fact: In the Philippines, balut is the undisputed king of midnight street food. You’ll usually hear the vendor before you see them, calling out "Baluuuut!" into the quiet night air. It’s a savory delicacy eaten in distinct steps: crack a small hole at the top, sip the rich, warm broth inside, and then season the rest with salt and vinegar. For street vendors working the graveyard shift, it’s a vital burst of energy to keep the shadows at bay.

The Game

Hapunan is a tense, story-driven psychological horror experience steeped in the dark underbelly of Filipino culture and folklore.

What began as a passion project built in the Unity Engine has transformed into a gritty, atmospheric nightmare designed to keep players on the edge of their seats. As a debut release, Hapunan delivers a raw, uncompromising look at survival, sacrifice, and the terrifying realities that hide just beneath the surface of everyday life.

The Story

Step into the worn-out slippers of Niko, a hardworking street vendor just trying to make an honest living selling balut under the dim glow of midnight streetlamps.

All Niko wanted was a standard business permit to keep his livelihood afloat. Who wouldn't want to experience the fun and safe experience of breaking down walls with a car? It looks simple: you have to hit a cube in the wall that is the same color as your car. Crashing into the wrong block costs you one life. Power-ups can add extra lives or make the game easier. Colliding with obstacles and hitting a tree or other objects near the road (except for small ones, of course) also costs one life, but the game continues.

The car’s speed gradually increases, demanding sharper reflexes and quicker thinking. Only true racing champions can react perfectly at high speeds. The music dynamizes with your speed, adding to the excitement. You can compare your driving skills on a global leaderboard against other players.

Control:

▶️ , D - turn right

◀️ , A - turn left

🔽 , S - stabilizes the car

🔼 , W - attract bonus when you get a magnet

or Controller D-pad and buttons: A, B

Esc - Pause menu

Power-ups overview:

 Plus extra life

 Magnet for bonuses

  Flying over the road

 Adds life after attracted by a magnet

 Temporary protective shield

 Bigger car and the right color add life

  Leave only one column of the nearest wall

 Slow down the speed by half

 Makes a small passage in the wall

 Car will shrink

The game features a gradual progression of difficulty:

First round - very easy

Second round - easy

Third round - medium

Fourth round - hard

Fifth round - very hard

Sixth round - exceptional skill

Seventh round - unique skill

Next rounds - mission impossible?

Environments:

The game offers a choice of 4 different environments: Forest, Tundra, Greece and Asia. Each environment is randomly generated, so it’s always slightly different, but the track remains the same to keep the leaderboard fair. Sometimes the horses under the hood might get wild, you can tame your car quickly with a special button. For lower-end computers, you can select low vegetation density to reduce performance requirements. It's best to crash into all the walls, because after avoiding five, you'll complete a penalty round without walls, and therefore without the opportunity to increase your score. What more can I say. Try the game and experience everything for yourself. The car is already waiting at the start.

Let’s see who can drive better and react faster!

store_data.about_the_game:
THE FLESH BENEATH is a body-horror deck-building roguelike. You play one of thirteen

ruined souls descending into the cathedral under an old village — fighting through

waves of grasping enemies, paying for your strongest cards in pieces of yourself,

and dying so the dark can remember you.

═══════════════════════════════

THE BARGAIN

═══════════════════════════════

Every run begins the same way. Three candidates are drafted from the bloodlines —

Cleaver, Hexweaver, Sister, Bonewright, Penitent, Sin-Eater, Bleeder, Whisper —

each named anew with a thematic epithet: Masha, Sorrow-Bringer. Yelena, of the

Wet Wheel. Boris, the Twice-Buried.

You pick one. Then the altar offers you One Last Gift.

Cut off an arm. Pluck an eye. Replace your heart with quieter machinery. Each

sacrifice costs maximum HP for the entire run — but grants a powerful flesh card

drawn from a pool of possibilities. Fourteen body parts are available. None of

them are decorative.

═══════════════════════════════

THE DESCENT

═══════════════════════════════

The cathedral branches. Every two steps you choose what comes next:

• Combat — multi-wave fights against detailed enemies that walk in from the dark

• Elite — fewer but tougher monsters

• Shrine — sever another piece for another card

• Rest — heal, meditate, or pray for souls

• Omen — a 3-choice encounter (40+ unique events)

• Gemcutter — press a blood-stone into a card socket

• Trader — buy cards and gems with souls

• Boss — every seven floors, something named is waiting

═══════════════════════════════

THE BOSSES

═══════════════════════════════

• THE BUTCHER

• THE MOTHER OF WOUNDS

• THE WARDEN

• THE QUEEN OF SORROWS - bridal veil dragging on stone, knife-tipped fingers, halo of orbiting runes

Defeating each unique boss for the first time unlocks a new hidden bloodline

for future runs.
AND MORE

═══════════════════════════════

THE CARDS

═══════════════════════════════

Cards come from your class, from shrines, from shops, from random events, from

the dark in your own body.

• Around 200 base cards across 13 bloodlines + 20+ body-part flesh cards

• Six gem types

• Socket cap per card scales with cost

• Stunning, weakening, poisoning, draining, summoning, blocking, healing —

every card type has visible animations and per-target slash arcs

═══════════════════════════════

THE CAMP

═══════════════════════════════

Souls you bring back are spent in the Carrion Camp — a five-building hub you

navigate by clicking, scroll-wheel, or arrow keys:

• THE TAVERN — five-path RPG skill tree, fifty tiers total. Path of Flesh

(max HP, regen, revive). Path of Bone (sacrifice mechanics). Path of Iron

(block, damage). Path of Shadow (cards, energy). Path of Souls (economy).

• BLACKSMITH — permanently upgrade individual cards with extra gem sockets

• HOUSE OF LITANY — every death recorded with name, depth, cause, and which

body parts were missing when they fell

• HALL OF DEEDS — fourteen achievements

• GATES OF HELL — start the next descent

═══════════════════════════════

THE WAY IT FEELS

═══════════════════════════════

• Three-step camera Z-line on every melee hit

• Curved slash arcs that sweep across each enemy

• Camera carousel that rotates to face whichever building you select

• Sequential per-enemy combat animations — telegraph, lunge, recoil, slash

• Procedural soundtrack that shifts per scene and per combat depth

• Fourteen rotating monster death roars and human death screams

• Visible armor on enemies that have block

• Crafted icons on every card

═══════════════════════════════

THE PROMISE

═══════════════════════════════

Permadeath. Every death is named in the Litany of Suffering. The camp remembers

your runs forever. The Door of Gems opens after three successful runs through

the Mother — only then can you reach the Queen and end her.

Give what the dark asks. Become less. Reach further.

═══════════════════════════════

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW BEFORE BUYING

═══════════════════════════════

THE FLESH BENEATH depicts body horror as its central mechanic — severed limbs,

self-mutilation at altars, blood-stones pressed into your own skin. The

violence is stylized but unflinching. The game treats it as a cost the player

chooses, not as spectacle. If body horror is a hard line for you, this is

not the game.

No microtransactions. No DRM. No ads. Buy once, play forever, offline if you want.

About This Game

This is a 3D narrative adventure where you walk through the city, talk with its residents, and move the story forward through your choices.

Third District, an abandoned city.

The main character wakes up there with no memory.

Players explore the 3D city, meet its residents, talk with them, and progress through the story by choosing YES or NO.

Even in the same places, the conversations and events you encounter will gradually change depending on when you visit, what items you have, and the choices you have made so far.

Your accumulated actions will determine how the story ends.

What You Do

Walk

Freely explore Third District and take in the atmosphere of the city and the everyday lives of its residents.

Meet

Choose where to go, talk with the residents, and discover events that change depending on your items and choices.

Choose

Every choice is either YES or NO.

These small choices, accumulated over time, will slowly change the story.
